rules.title: 45-Day Decision Window for District Authority
rules.description: The District Authority must examine the MP's recommendation and either accord administrative sanction or convey formal rejection with reasons within 45 days.

rules.title: 18-Month Standard Project Execution Window
rules.description: All approved public infrastructure works should ordinarily be completed within 18 months from the date of administrative sanction.

rules.title: Single Installment Direct Entitlement
rules.description: Funds are allocated directly to the MP's Central Nodal Account in a single annual installment of ₹5 Crore starting Financial Year 2023-24.

rules.title: Out-of-Constituency Expenditure Limit
rules.description: An MP may recommend developmental works outside their constituency within the state or country up to a maximum limit of ₹50 Lakh annually.

rules.title: Mandatory SC/ST Earmarked Allocation
rules.description: MPs must recommend works contributing at least 15% of annual funds in areas inhabited by Scheduled Caste population and 7.5% for Scheduled Tribe population.

rules.title: Disaster & Calamity Contribution Limits
rules.description: MPs can contribute up to ₹1 Crore for calamity relief in their state and up to ₹1 Crore for calamity of severe nature in any other part of the country.

rules.title: Prohibition of Non-Permissible / Commercial Assets
rules.description: Public funds cannot be utilized for commercial assets, places of worship, memorials, or private property improvements.
